player_intent: Jump to reachable ledges, hang and pull up, climb ladders and hold Jump to slide down.
acceptance_rule: Raised-hand reach is relative to current physical feet; clear supported tops accept climbs, too-high/blocked/opt-out geometry rejects them. Hanging waits for pull-up or drop. Ladder input supports up/down, tap detach and hold-slide/release grip. Existing traversal context survives movement-state codec round-trip. CharacterBody remains the only movement writer.

nodes.role: Consumes movement commands and applies traversal velocities
Authored detection volume and endpoints, never moves player

visual_check: Inspect dedicated retargeted pull-up, stable hang, safe landing and distance-driven ladder movement/slide. Runtime hip anchoring prevents duplicate body lift. Exact hand-contact polish remains; ladder art and markers must be placed in desired maps.

system_delta.reason: Existing vault only lands behind cover; extend its collision owner and serialized context for ledge tops, hangs and ladder states.
